gaps.sentence: She resigned ___ the grounds of ill health.
gaps.explanation: 'on the grounds of' = for the reason of.

gaps.sentence: Profits rose ___ 40 per cent, far beyond even the optimistic forecasts.
gaps.explanation: 'By' expresses the size of the increase: rose by 40 per cent.

gaps.sentence: He stayed ___ touch with every colleague he'd ever had.
The new policy was introduced ___ response to rising demand.
gaps.explanation: 'in response to' = as a reaction to.

gaps.sentence: ___ theory the plan is sound; in practice it fails.
gaps.explanation: 'In theory' contrasts the idea with reality.

gaps.sentence: The evidence establishes guilt ___ reasonable doubt.
gaps.explanation: 'Beyond reasonable doubt' — the legal standard of proof.

gaps.sentence: Everything was packed ready in ___ of the movers' arrival.
The two versions differ in several ___ ; the ending is the biggest.
